project.name: Bonnybank
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 10 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Bonnybank Inn is a full pub/restaurant and is excluded from the café-focused Eat list. Kennoway Den is a Kennoway attraction and does not support this hamlet score.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Bonnybank is genuinely served by the Fife Pilgrim Way and Kingskettle walking network, but it has no independent visitor attraction or café-led daytime offer and its inn is a full pub/restaurant.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access can work for responsible dog visits; venue-specific policies are recorded individually.
